name: Enquiries
description: One inbox for everything a visitor asks: a callback, a question about a product, "tell me when it is back", a message. The answers are stored — not emailed and forgotten — and every enquiry is an automations trigger.

settings.label: Send new enquiries to
settings.help: Empty means the storefront's own contact address. One email is sent by this module itself, so an enquiry is never lost waiting for somebody to set up a rule; anything beyond it — a messenger, a webhook, a reminder — is an automation.

settings.label: Offer a callback
settings.help: Puts the callback dialog on every storefront page and points the {callback_link} token at it. Off, and the token goes back to dialling the shop's number — content written with it keeps working either way.

settings.label: Close an answered enquiry after, hours
settings.help: 0 keeps every thread open until somebody closes it. Otherwise a thread the SHOP spoke last in is closed once that answer is this old — the customer said nothing back, so there is nothing to answer. A thread the customer spoke last in is never closed by this, however old: that is an unanswered question, not a finished one.

settings.label: Answer within, hours
settings.help: The shop's own promise. An enquiry the shop owes an answer to for longer than this is marked red in the inbox. 0 turns the mark off.

settings.label: "Ask about this product" on the product page
"Tell me when it is back" on out-of-stock products
settings.help: Shown only when the product really is out of stock: offering to notify somebody about something sitting on the shelf reads as a broken shop.

settings.label: Photos a customer may attach
settings.help: Per enquiry and per reply, counted against what that message already holds. 0 turns attachments off everywhere. Photographs only — the size limit and the formats are the Media module's, and a file is checked by what it actually is rather than by its name.
